BL-1368 — Every approval commit claims 'By coder.' because the byline is a hardcoded literal, so a decision only a human can make is recorded in git as an agent's work
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-03 by the specifier while adjudicating QA's BL-1309 note. The
investigation had to read the bot's source to discover the byline was a
literal; until then the evidence genuinely did read as an agent self-flip,
which is the whole point of filing this.
Approval context: No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. The remedy is a string and the only real question - what it should say instead - is the implementer's, bounded by invariant 1. . What to know before approving. This is small and it is not cosmetic. Every agent in this swarm commits as `t <t@t>`, s…
